# orca agent

Every `orca agent` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca agent list`

the agent installations the panel can run

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).

## `orca agent models <installation>`

an installation's models

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<installation>`: an installation id

## `orca agent set-preferences --file <file>`

set the operator's agent preferences from a JSON file

- What it does: sends control verb `set-agent-preferences`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--file <file>` (required): the preferences JSON (orca-agent-preferences-v1 .preferences)

## `orca agent apply-update --accept <accept>`

apply the detected installation changes named by --accept

- What it does: sends control verb `apply-agent-update`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `--accept <accept>` (required) (repeatable): a change id from the update preview (repeatable)

## `orca agent init`

detect the installed agents (ccloop agents detect) and write the installation table; an existing table is never overwritten (the detection goes to <table>.draft.json)

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused by name.

```
orca agent init
```

## `orca agent show`

validate the installation table and print what each installation resolves to; exit 1 if any entry is refused

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused by name.

```
orca agent show
```

## `orca agent refresh`

record the version each installed CLI answers now in the table (only the version fields change)

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: anyone; runs here, needs no panel.
- Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused by name.

```
orca agent refresh
```
